newsitem.title: USA: DLJ says Comcast Cellular debt deal not postponed.
newsitem.headline: DLJ says Comcast Cellular debt deal not postponed.

text.p: Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette syndicate officials on Monday denied rumors a planned $900 million high-yield debt offering from Comcast Corp unit Comcast Cellular Holdings Inc had been postponed.
However, other buy- and sell-side sources indicated the issue has been postponed for two weeks. Sources speculated the current deterioration in high-yield prices prompted the move.
The roadshow for the deal was said slated to begin on April 2, according to market sources.
Comcast did not immediately return a telephone call.
Further information from DLJ was not available.
